# Project Engineering Instructions

## Project context

This repository is a software engineering laboratory
for practicing multi-agent development workflows.

Technology stack:
- C#
- .NET
- GitHub Copilot
- Git

## Engineering principles

- Prefer simple solutions over unnecessary complexity.
- Follow existing architecture and naming conventions.
- Do not introduce dependencies without justification.
- Keep changes scoped to the assigned task.
- Write tests for business behavior.
- Never report tests as passed unless executed.
- Document assumptions and technical risks.

## Human authority

The human user acts as Product Owner and Tech Lead.

The human must approve:
- Significant architecture changes.
- Changes outside an approved task scope.
- Pull Request integration.
- Destructive operations.

## Agent collaboration

- Use explicit task objectives and acceptance criteria.
- Distinguish implementation completion from acceptance.
- Report blockers instead of inventing requirements.
- Review implementation independently.
